title: AI failed a riddle a kid can solve

beats.say: Most AI chatbots failed this simple question.

beats.sub: How many sisters does her brother have?
beats.say: Alice has four brothers and one sister. How many sisters does Alice's brother have?
The answer is two. Her sister, and Alice herself.
Many AIs said one. They forgot Alice is a sister too.
In a 2024 study, the best model got it right about sixty five percent of the time. Others, almost never.

beats.sub: with made-up reasoning to back it up
beats.say: And they were sure of it, inventing reasoning to defend the wrong answer.
Tweak the numbers, and scores swung wildly. Newer reasoning models do better. Try it yourself.
